Please read the following terms carefully before use, including the disclaimer and privacy policy

OpenDroidChat is a graphical LLM API chat client. It does not provide, generate, or create any content. All content displayed or output through this application is generated entirely by third-party API services that you connect to, and is unrelated to the developers of this application.
Users should fully understand and agree to the following terms:
1. This application serves solely as a graphical interface tool for API calls and does not participate in the generation, modification, review, or distribution of any content.
2. The user assumes full responsibility for the accuracy, legality, compliance, and any consequences of content generated by third-party API services.

3. The developers shall not be liable for any direct or indirect damages arising from the use of this application, including but not limited to data loss, business interruption, reputation damage, or other economic losses.
4. Users must ensure their usage complies with applicable laws and the terms and policies of third-party API providers.
5. The developers reserve the right to modify this disclaimer at any time. Modified terms take effect immediately upon publication. Users are advised to review this page periodically.

All answers, code, and suggestions shown in this app are generated by the third-party Large Language Model (LLM) API you configure. This app does not produce, edit, or review that content. AI-generated content may be inaccurate, outdated, or misleading and must not be used as the basis for decisions in medical, legal, financial, or other professional fields.

When you enable an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, the model may request the tools that server exposes during a conversation. Tool calls are executed by the third-party server itself and may read, modify, or delete data, or send requests to external services. Enable only servers you trust, and evaluate the risks yourself before use.

This app only forwards tool requests and results. It is not responsible for the availability, security, returned values, or side effects of any MCP server. Any loss caused by invoking third-party tools is borne by the user.

Review any code, commands, or operational suggestions generated by the model before executing them.

Data storage: Your model configurations, API keys (encrypted with the Android Keystore), conversation history, and preferences are stored only in private app storage on this device. This app provides no cloud sync and does not upload this data to the developer or any third-party server.

Network transfer: This app connects directly to the API provider or MCP server you configure only when you send a message, fetch MCP tools, or invoke a tool. It sends only the information required for that request (conversation content, system prompt, the file content you selected, and tool arguments). This information never passes through a server controlled by the developer.

Data collection: The developer does not collect, store, or sell any personal information. This app contains no analytics, advertising, or telemetry SDKs and does not collect usage data in the background.

Update checks: When you enable "Automatically check for updates" or check manually, the app contacts GitHub Releases for version information. That request contains no conversation content or API keys.

Third-party services: Your LLM provider, MCP servers, and GitHub each have their own privacy policies. Their data processing is not controlled by this app; please review their terms.

Data deletion: You can delete a single conversation or clear all history at any time. Uninstalling the app removes all configurations and conversation data stored on this device.

Minors: If you are a minor, use this app under the guidance of a guardian and avoid entering sensitive personal information.
Before using OpenDroidChat, please read and agree to the Legal & Privacy Policy, which covers the disclaimer, MCP tool call risks, and privacy policy.
